metaFingerprint.description:
Fingerprint about the important meta information about objs in this row. Helps determine changes to the type after the data
was partitioned. Fields of importance are typeName, partitionKeyField, persistenceOrder, persistDuplicates, defaultPartitionStrategy

schemaVersion.description: Schema version for the given row configuration. Useful while upgrading bucketing strategy

buckets.description: Ordered list of buckets where data is stored

title: Holds information about the location & other meta info of where actual data is stored in a given {@link KvRow}
